propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY inline PEM is captured into cfg.private_key but never removed from os.environ, remaining visible to child processes like ssh-keygen and git
The variable persists in os.environ for the process lifetime after OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() returns, exposing the raw PEM to crash handlers, error reporters, and environment dumps
OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() is the sole caller of _private_key_env() and is invoked exactly once at module scope in app.py, so consuming-on-read is safe without reload concerns
Removing the variable from os.environ after config load prevents it from being inherited by spawned child processes but does not remove it from process memory or proc environ on Linux
